Class Book

java.lang.Object
com.booklibrary.model.Book
public class Book extends Object
Represents a single book in the private library collection. Author: Farid Rahmani Contribution: Designed the domain model and relationships between books, writers, genres and bookshelves. Purpose: the central domain entity of the application. A book is linked to exactly one Writer, one Genre and one Bookshelf, and carries its own ReadingStatus.
